method: Compile immutable source geometry; apply ordered saved boundary/window retirement facts through the selected event; inspect fuel/contact versus representative-cell segments. No burn rerun.

reports.name: kitchen

initialDomain.note: Initial static receiver eligibility/order is reconstructed exactly from the unchanged compiler. Cold material/receiver changes are pre-combustion fixture effects, not automatically defects. The profile-only nonburning counterfactual preserves all these fields and .25 per-cell capacity.

limitations: These are the same canonical boundary paths as the heat kernel, not full renderer/furniture occlusion.
An exposed face path is a potential geometry path, not proof that the sampled/delayed radiation budget used that link.
Current event order reconstructs boundary state through the ignition event; there are no door commands.
Co-located heat has no internal wall/soil test; actual geometry must be inspected separately.
reports.upwardLimitation: If soil blocks this below-ground representative path, the kernel can suppress above-ground return and redirect blocked upward energy laterally under its existing ceiling rule. A plausible ring time does not validate that route.

allCoLocatedDebris.note: All co-located burning house residue groups are included. A retained final footprint overlap supports spatial contact, but does not uniquely attribute heat or its rate at ignition.

hotDebrisToGrass.interpretation: Observed burning debris landed on overlapping grass. Shared-cell heating is consistent with contact, but the calibrated mechanism/rate is not uniquely identified.

grassToAbovePlinthWall.interpretation: Potential return geometry at first grass ignition; check whether this wall had already ignited. Not a demonstrated grass-caused first ignition.

grassToPorchInspection.interpretation: Nearest previously ignited grass is a spatial candidate only; this unchanged kernel does not attribute porch heat to one source.
